title: Ray sensitivities (forward-mode tangents)
description: Phase 4 step 3: dy/dtheta of traced rays on the GPU in fp64, from the compiler's symbolic JVP (rm/tangent.h) and from Dual numbers through the ordinary integrator (rm/dual.h), against the JS reference tracer and against analytic sensitivities: the Schwarzschild shadow angle against camera radius, the Kerr critical impact parameter against spin, and the Schwarzschild sweep angle against impact parameter.
